# Craftable Totem of Undying 

```

```

**Add a simple and fun way to craft the Totem of Immortality in Minecraft! This datapack lets you craft a special totem that grants extra protection, compatible with Minecraft versions 1.21.8, 1.21.9, and 1.21.10.**

✅ Easy to install – just drop it into your datapacks folder.

✅ Vanilla-friendly – no mods required.

✅ Works in survival and creative modes.


Enhance your adventures and stay safe from unexpected deaths!
